description: Collections are rows of iam_records (collection, id, tenant_id, unique_key, data); data is JSON.stringify(record) with camelCase fields. Every record has string id and tenantId; uniqueKey, when present, is unique per (collection, tenantId). The per-collection details are read from the call sites: record types (TypeScript type arguments), filter keys, findOrdered fields and the expressions that build uniqueKey.

storage.collectionsSql: SELECT DISTINCT collection FROM iam_records ORDER BY collection
storage.idOrder: code-point (UTF-8 byte) order: SQLite BINARY, PostgreSQL COLLATE "C" (compareIds)

limits.identifierRules: collection, id, tenantId and uniqueKey: nonempty strings of at most 512 UTF-16 units and 512 UTF-8 bytes, no U+0000-U+001F, no unpaired surrogates (INVALID_RECORD)
